TWO THINGS THE PRD ITSELF SURFACES AND DOES NOT PATCH, carried so they are not lost with the message. (a) FWD-8 IS NOT FOLDED AWAY: he observed FWD-8 "can be folded into" FWD-7, and the REPORT CONTENT is genuinely folded, but the AUTHORIZATION is not -- FWD-8 fires BEFORE egress and ASKS PERMISSION, FWD-7 fires AFTER egress has already failed and REPORTS. Whether card 4 stops being a named outcome is HIS call.
